description: Java source code for REST controllers managing domain-related modules such as projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications within a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: DomainControllers
classes.description: Spring REST controller managing various domain modules such as projects, contractors, tenders, contracts, milestones, inspections, handovers, funds, payments, and notifications.

methods.name: createProject
methods.description: Creates a new project with provided data.

methods.name: listProjects
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of projects.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches project details by ID.

methods.name: updateProject
methods.description: Performs a partial update on a project.

methods.name: deleteProject
methods.description: Deletes a project by ID.

methods.name: createContractor
methods.description: Creates a new contractor.

methods.name: listContractors
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of contractors.

methods.name: updateContractor
methods.description: Updates details of an existing contractor.

methods.name: createTender
methods.description: Creates a new tender associated with a project.

methods.name: listTenders
methods.description: Lists tenders for a specific project.

methods.name: updateTender
methods.description: Updates details of a tender.

methods.name: createContract
methods.description: Creates a contract for a project and contractor.

methods.name: listContracts
methods.description: Lists contracts associated with a project.

methods.name: updateContract
methods.description: Updates contract details.

methods.name: createMilestone
methods.description: Creates a new project milestone.

methods.name: listMilestones
methods.description: Lists milestones for a project.

methods.name: updateMilestone
methods.description: Updates milestone details.

methods.name: updateMilestoneProgress
methods.description: Updates milestone progress along with optional geotag info.

methods.name: createInspection
methods.description: Records an inspection with optional geotagging.

methods.name: recordHandover
methods.description: Records project handover and marks project as completed.

methods.name: createFund
methods.description: Records a fund allocation or release for a project.

methods.name: createPayment
methods.description: Creates a payment entry to contractor or project.

methods.name: updatePaymentStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a payment (approve, reject, pay).

methods.name: getNotifications
methods.description: Fetches notifications for a specific user.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Admins send notifications to users.
